A camp of dark goat-hair tents of Jacob's household on a gentle slope, large flocks of sheep and goats. In the middle ground the young Joseph from the reference sheet (same face, same long-sleeved tunic with woven bands) walks toward the camp, while a group of his older brothers, shepherds in plain undyed wool, stand apart with the flocks on the far side, a visible distance between them.
